claims.head: The Devils will send Kovacevic and Chisholm at Bjorkstrand
claims.call: The Devils’ P3 (Kovacevic and Chisholm) spends at least 28% of its 5-on-5 time against the Rangers’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Devils keep sending Kovacevic and Chisholm out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Sheldon Keefe has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ fourth lines. Tonight the Rangers’ fourth line is Bjorkstrand, Chmelař and Beaudoin.

claims.head: The Devils better keep their heads up
claims.body: On physicality, the Rangers are one of the league’s best, but New Jersey is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Rangers.

NJD.head: Advantage, the Devils
NJD.body: New Jersey has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Rangers can make it interesting if they get good looks.
